verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS ships ready-to-use, plug-and-play ROS 2 packages for common behaviors: navigation, perception, object detection, collision detection, trajectory optimization, localization, mapping and manipulation. Isaac Lab adds batteries-included robot assets, and Isaac Sim is distributed as pip-installable namespace packages, which gives a reusable-module ecosystem. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented registry or distribution channel for the Isaac ROS packages, reusable hardware or sensor driver packages (only robot assets are evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration of pulling and reusing these packages.
